content:
Following the official rollout of its Liquid Glass redesign to most WhatsApp users on iOS, the messaging platform is now testing another visual change, this time focused on the look of its chat bubbles. Here are the details.

New chat bubbles look slightly more rounded

A couple of months ago, WhatsApp finally began rolling out its Liquid Glass redesign more broadly, following several months of testing and refining the new look with select users through TestFlight.

Around the same time, WABetaInfo uncovered references in the app’s code pointing to a redesign of WhatsApp’s chat bubbles. Now, the site reports that new bubbles are beginning to reach select users running the latest TestFlight build.

Here’s WABetaInfo:

In addition to reshaping message bubbles, the new design changes how media and links appear in conversations. WhatsApp has removed the green outline surrounding them, giving photos, videos, GIFs, and link previews a cleaner, more integrated look.

WABetaInfo notes that the new look is available to select users running WhatsApp’s TestFlight build. Right now, there is no word on when it will roll out more broadly to all users on iOS.
